## Task and change

What concrete job does this addition help finish? What changed?

## Primary sources

Link the official repository/documentation supporting the capability and requirements.

## Review

- [ ] Both READMEs and the catalog agree.
- [ ] Canonical URL and archive status checked; review date included.
- [ ] Interface, model/service preparation and edition/license differences stated.
- [ ] No unperformed runtime test or generated-output claim.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, affiliate links or paid placement.
